allowedResources: A JDK 25 and Apache Maven 3.9 with the pinned Spring Boot 4.1.2 dependencies downloaded before the timed work (the platform template, or mvn -q dependency:go-offline); no external database, network or AI service is needed during the timed work
Any further resource rule (course pages, documentation, notes) is set and shown by the platform assessment owner
instructions: Final Assessment coding challenge, Spring (intermediate, 20 minutes from the end of setup, reading included). Complete PickupOrder.addLine (both sides of the relationship) and OrderService.place so that POST /api/orders saves the order with its lines and reserves stock, all or nothing: a failing line or a refused database write changes nothing. Run mvn -q -o test in starter/; the score is the share of the 8 checks that pass, pass mark 70%.
